correctness.rationale: the component lemma for paths and cycles realizes every multiplicity vector bounded by the component independence number. The global max-flow reduction has singleton cuts equal to the independence bound, two-color cuts equal to the total order minus the number of odd-cycle components, and all larger cuts automatic. An independent exhaustive check over every unlabeled path/cycle component multiset through order 9 tested 3,885 graph/partition cases and matched the theorem in every case.
